title: Fractional Wiener chaos: Part 2. Interface spectral chaos
summary: We construct a product spectral decomposition from power-normalised parabolic-cylinder functions. At noninteger real orders, these functions are not square integrable with respect to the corresponding full-line Gaussian measure. Bringing the admissible half-line branches into the same Gaussian space and matching them at the origin gives a corrected orthonormal eigenbasis. A unitary transformation to a weighted probability space makes the eigenfunction corresponding to the lowest eigenvalue constant and permits consistent countable products.
